# the parts of each character are recorded here; no outline of the font is.
# Coordinates are thousandths of the ideographic character face, y downwards.
# path: child indices from the character (the frame of a surround is 0, its inside 1).
# cut: thousandths of the parent's ink cut to separate the part (0 = a clean split).
# amb: 1 if another cut of the parent was nearly as good (the split may be wrong).
# walls: of a surround's frame, where its ink comes closest to the inside on the left, top,
#   right and bottom (within the inside's rows or columns; '-' where open).
